standard_prerequisites.name: Absolute Noetherian approximation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits, Lemma limits-lemma-descend-finite-presentation, with Lemma lemma-descend-nodal-family and Divisors, Lemma divisors-lemma-base-change-and-fitting-ideal-omega
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the reduction to S of finite type over Z: write R = colim R_i, descend f to f_i at-worst-nodal of relative dimension 1 with x_i a singular point of the fibre.

standard_prerequisites.name: Artin approximation for the completed local algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Morphisms, Lemma more-morphisms-lemma-relative-map-approximation-pre, with More on Algebra, Proposition more-algebra-proposition-ubiquity-G-ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the completed isomorphism O_{X,x}^wedge = O_{Y_sigma,y_sigma}^wedge into an etale-local isomorphism after an etale neighbourhood, since O_{S,s} is a G-ring.

core_obligations: Approximation reduction (proof lines 5319-5335): X, S affine, R = colim R_i with f_i at-worst-nodal whose base change is f; the image x_i is singular on the fibre because Sing(f) commutes with base change; the lemma for (f_i, x_i) implies the lemma for (f, x).

Etale neighbourhood realizing the node's residue data (proof lines 5338-5355): kappa(x)/kappa(s) is finite separable, and the degree 2 separable algebra kappa' of Remark remark-quadratic-extension is realized by an etale neighbourhood (V, v) -> (S, s); replace X by X x_S V and S by V so the node is split.

Completed normal form (proof lines 5358-5390): for the split node, Lemma lemma-formal-local-structure-nodal-family gives O_{X,x}^wedge = O_{S,s}^wedge[[s, t]]/(st - h); with sigma : Z[a] -> O_{S,s}^wedge sending a to h this is exactly the completed local isomorphism with Y_sigma = Spec(Z[u, v, t]/(uv - a)) x_{Spec(Z[a]), sigma} Spec(O_{S,s}^wedge), and Artin approximation concludes.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to finite type over Z by absolute Noetherian approximation and descend the nodal condition.
After an etale base change realizing the separable residue field extension, assume the node is split.
Read the completed normal form st - h off the split-node lemma and package it as the fibre product Y_sigma.
Apply Artin approximation (G-ring property) to descend the completed isomorphism to an etale neighbourhood, giving the diagram with cartesian right square.
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the standard etale-local model of a nodal family (statement lines 5293-5312 with the two-square diagram). The proof (lines 5314-5388) is a three-stage argument: absolute Noetherian approximation to reduce to finite type over Z, an etale base change that realizes the degree 2 separable residue algebra of the node so that it becomes split, and finally Artin approximation applied to the completed isomorphism with the explicit model algebra Z[u, v, a]/(uv - a). H3: each stage is a genuine technique and the composition with the base-change compatibility of the singular locus is not routine.
